documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: An earlier inquiry from our manufacturing team requested discovery about duplicate follow-ups. The latest call says the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement. Please clarify the contradictory project information before proposing a meeting.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer's operational friction involves 'duplicate follow-ups' and a 'project paused' status, with conflicting information about the requirement. The manufacturing team previously requested a discovery meeting, but the latest call indicates disagreement about the requirement, and the project is paused. This creates uncertainty about the need for integration and workflow coordination.

claims.quote: An earlier inquiry from our manufacturing team requested discovery about duplicate follow-ups.
The latest call says the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement.

raw_proposal.draft: We understand that your manufacturing team previously requested a discovery meeting to address duplicate follow-ups, but the latest call indicates the project is paused and there's disagreement about the requirement. To ensure we align with your needs, could you clarify the current status of the project and confirm whether the integration of workflow coordination and account reporting is still required?
questions: Could you clarify the current status of the project and whether the integration of workflow coordination and account reporting is still required?
Are there any specific concerns or disagreements about the requirement that need to be addressed before moving forward?
uncertainties: The project is paused, and there is a disagreement about the requirement.
The need for integration and workflow coordination is unclear due to conflicting information.
